title: Robotic Intern
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for students looking to kick-start their careers. Please review the Job Description shared below and apply if your skills and interests align with the role. 
 Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Design and prototype electronic systems for rapid testing and development. Assist in mechanical assembly, wiring, and hardware integration of robotic platforms. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Interface with hardware using UART, CAN, IC, SPI, USB, and wireless communication protocols. Implement safety mechanisms, telemetry systems, and fault-detection routines. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Contribute innovative ideas to improve system reliability and performance. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with robotics, embedded, AI, mechanical, and software engineers. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team. 
 Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with robotics, embedded systems, drones, autonomous vehicles, or related projects. Proficiency in Python and basic C/C++ programming. Understanding of sensors, control systems, communication protocols, and microcontroller-based development. Experience with hardware assembly, wiring, debugging, and soldering. Comfortable working on both software and physical hardware systems. 
 Nice-to-Haves: Experience with ROS 2 and robotic middleware. Knowledge of SLAM, localization, path planning, and autonomous navigation. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar robotics/autonomy frameworks. Familiarity with OpenCV, computer vision, or AI-based perception systems. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu) development environments. Familiarity with CAD tools such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or Onshape. Understanding of wireless communication systems and telemetry. 
 Soft Skills: Self-driven and highly proactive. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Curious mindset with a passion for building real-world robotic systems. Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a rapid prototyping environment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 Why Join Us? End-to-End Engineering Experience:   Work on complete autonomous robotic systems from design and prototyping to testing and deployment. Advanced Robotics Exposure:   Gain hands-on experience in embedded systems, aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, perception, and ROS 2-based autonomy. Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development. 
 Internship Details: Duration:  3–6 Months
 Type:  Internship with mentorship, certification, and learning opportunities
 Location:  On-site at Fx31Labs, Ahmedabad 
 About Fx31Labs: Fx31Labs is an innovation-driven tech company delivering solutions at the intersection of robotics, AI, and software development. We specialize in building intelligent, scalable, and automation-first systems for startups and enterprises alike.

title: Planning Engineer/PPC Engineer
description:
Job description 
 Planning Engineer/ PPC Engineer(Production Planning and Control) Department : SCM & Operations
 Sub Department : Planning
 Work Location : Pirana, Near Ode Village, Aslali
 Mode of Work: In-office
 Working Days: Monday to Friday ( Saturday Sunday Week off)
 Working Time : 9:00 AM to 6.30PM
 Reporting To: SCM Head 
 About PressureJet Systems Pvt. Ltd. PressureJet Systems Pvt. Ltd. is a reputed manufacturing company in the high-pressure triplex plunger pump and engineered systems segment. We work with a strong focus on quality, timely delivery, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. We are looking for a capable and result-oriented Senior PPC Engineer who can strengthen our production planning and delivery control system. 
 Role Summary The Planning Engineer/Sr. Planning Engineer will be responsible for planning, scheduling, monitoring, and controlling production activities to ensure on-time delivery of customer orders with the required quality and quantity. This role is highly important because PPC acts as the central coordination point between Sales, Production, Machine Shop, Procurement, Quality, Testing, Warehouse, and Dispatch. 
 Key Responsibilities Review sales orders daily and prepare production plans based on demand, resource availability, capacity, and lead time. Prepare detailed production schedules considering material availability, production capacity, and delivery commitments. Release job orders and purchase requisitions as per order priority and production requirements. Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Machine Shop, Quality, Testing, Warehouse, Sales, and Service teams for smooth order execution. Monitor daily production progress and ensure adherence to the planned schedule. Identify and resolve material shortages, capacity issues, production delays, and scheduling conflicts. Provide advance written communication to Sales / Application teams in case of expected delay, rescheduling, or quality rejection. Prepare delay feedback and RCA inputs to prevent repeated issues. Lead order delivery review meetings and guide execution priorities. Prepare weekly and monthly reports related to order status, delivery performance, late delivery RCA, and unreleased jobs. Required Qualification BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering Required Experience 2 to 5 years of experience in Production Planning & Control. Experience in a discrete manufacturing industry will be preferred. Experience in handling or coordinating with a small support team will be an added advantage. 
 Required Skills Production Planning & Scheduling Material Planning Capacity Planning ERP / SAP / Oracle knowledge Advanced Excel Progress Monitoring Inventory Management Data Analysis Problem Solving Cross-functional Coordination Follow-up and Reporting Delivery Performance Monitoring 
 What Kind of Candidate Are We Looking For? We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and growth-oriented Planning Engineer/Senior Planning Engineer who does not wait for instructions but actively takes ownership of planning, follow-up, coordination, and delivery commitments. 
 The ideal candidate should have: Positive attitude and willingness to take responsibility. Strong ownership mindset for customer order delivery. Habit of continuous follow-up until the task is completed. Strong belief in continuous learning and continuous improvement. Accountability for results, not only for assigned tasks. Confidence to communicate delays, risks, and issues in advance. Readiness to work in a challenging manufacturing environment. Getting things done attitude with discipline and professional maturity. At PressureJet, we value people who are active, accountable, positive, disciplined, and improvement-focused. If you are someone who wants to grow with responsibility and contribute directly to customer satisfaction, this role can be a strong career opportunity for you. 
 Who Should Apply? This role is suitable for candidates currently working as: PPC Engineer Senior PPC Engineer Production Planning Engineer Planning Engineer SCM Planning Engineer

description:
Job Title: AI Software Engineer Laravel & AI-Driven Development (AIDLC) Experience Level: 36 years | Location/Type: Permanent About the Role We're looking for an AI Software Engineer who blends strong backend engineering (PHP/Laravel) with two complementary AI skill sets: 1. Building AI-powered products — integrating LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, and AI agents into real applications. 2. Practicing AI-Driven Development (AIDLC) — using AI coding assistants and automation (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT) throughout the development lifecycle to design, code, test, review, and document software faster and more reliably. This isn't just "an AI engineer" or "a Laravel developer" — it's someone who ships production Laravel applications and uses AI tools as a core part of how they work, while also building AI capabilities into the product itself. You'll work closely with product, engineering, and operations teams to design, develop, integrate, and maintain intelligent software solutions — end to end. Key Responsibilities AI Product Development Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications and features. Integrate OpenAI, LLMs, Generative AI models, and third-party AI APIs into business applications. Build AI agents, chatbots, automation workflows, and intelligent assistants. Work with prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and AI pipelines. Evaluate and optimize AI models for accuracy, performance, reliability, and cost. AI-Driven Development (AIDLC) 
 Use AI coding assistants (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT) to accelerate design, coding, refactoring, and documentation. Apply AI-assisted code review, test generation, and debugging to improve code quality and delivery speed. Build and refine internal prompts/workflows that make AI-assisted development safer, faster, and more consistent across the team. Balance AI-generated output with sound engineering judgment — reviewing, validating, and owning everything that ships. Backend Engineering Develop and maintain scalable backend applications using PHP and Laravel. Build and integrate REST APIs and third-party services. Design efficient data models, queries, and database schemas. Write clean, reusable, well-documented, and testable code. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing applications. Collaboration Translate business requirements into technical solutions with product, engineering, and ops stakeholders. Stay current on Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, AIDLC tooling, and software development practices. Required Technical Skills Programming Languages PHP / Laravel (strong, hands-on) Python JavaScript / TypeScript SQL HTML5 / CSS3 Advantage: Node.js, Java, or C#/.NET AI-Driven Development (AIDLC) Practical daily experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar) for coding, refactoring, testing, or documentation Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code rather than accept it at face value 
 Experience defining or improving AI-assisted engineering workflows/practices within a team AI / Machine Learning Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) OpenAI or similar AI APIs Prompt engineering RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Embeddings and vector databases AI agents / agentic AI Chatbot development ML and NLP fundamentals Model/API integration and evaluation Backend & Development REST API development and integration Microservices/API-based architecture Database design and optimization (MySQL/PostgreSQL or similar) Git/GitHub/GitLab Authentication and authorization Debugging and performance optimization Cloud & DevOps AWS / Azure / Google Cloud Docker CI/CD pipelines Linux Cloud-based AI/API deployments Good to Have 
 AI agent frameworks OpenAI Assistants/API, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar LLM platforms FastAPI or Flask Node.js Experience building SaaS or enterprise applications Knowledge of AI security, data privacy, and responsible AI practices 
 Experience deploying AI solutions to production Experience establishing or documenting AIDLC standards/playbooks for a team Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, AI, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 3–6 years of professional software development experience, including relevant AI/ML or Generative AI work. Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools in real projects (not just casual/occasional use). Strong programming and problem-solving skills; solid grasp of SDLC and coding best practices. Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
